Title: The Secret Must Be Kept - Rules Clarification

Messages.Author: erewego
Messages.Body:
Funny situation in last game I played.

I want to cycle this card but there are no allies or retainers in play.

Card Text:
The Secret Must Be Kept
Requires a Laibon
Choose an ally or a retainer. If the acting Laibon is a magaji, choose up to two allies or retainers. Successful referendum means the chosen allies and retainers are burned, and their controllers burn 1 pool (each methuselah burns no more than 1 pool, regardless of the number of allies and retainers chosen).

----
So I interpreted this as: if I have a laibon and there are no allies or retainers I cannot play it. BUT if I have a magaji, I can CHOOSE UP TO two allies... and ZERO is on the way "up to" two, so then I can play it.

The cycle was pretty moot in the game but I figured I should ask. Is this the correct interpretation?

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
The first sentence requires you to choose one. So to meet the text of the first sentence you must choose one. If you are a magaji, you must choose one (1st sentence) and you may choose up to two (2nd sentence).

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418
